title: The Phobjikha Valley, south of Nubding, is a wide and relatively flat agricultural valley.
description: The Phobjikha Valley, south of Nubding, is a wide and relatively flat agricultural valley. It is by far the largest open valley with no major river visible on Street View.

title: A hook can be seen on the back of the car in Haa District, mainly in the town of Ha.
description: A hook can be seen on the back of the car in Haa District, mainly in the town of Ha.

title: This interesting trekker with a black cover can be found in the city of Khulna.
description: This interesting trekker with a black cover can be found in the city of Khulna.

description: While the Paro International Airport is located in a dry northwest valley, the Bumthang Domestic Airport is located in a wet northern valley.

title: Late sunset coverage can be found in two places in the country; on a small rural sideroad in the east of Mongar District and in a significantly more urban area around the town of…
description: Late sunset coverage can be found in two places in the country; on a small rural sideroad in the east of Mongar District and in a significantly more urban area around the town of Paro in the west.

title: Gelephu Airport is the only airport located in the flat south part of Bhutan, making it recognisable.
description: Gelephu Airport is the only airport located in the flat south part of Bhutan, making it recognisable.

description: A trekker escorted by a security guard is found on Saint Martin's Island.

description: In the city of Barishal there can also be a guard at the side of the car visible, not to be confused with the Sylhet guard.

title: The Paro International Airport is located in a dry northwest valley and is one of the two northern airports.
description: The Paro International Airport is located in a dry northwest valley and is one of the two northern airports.

title: Białystok uses turquoise street signs, with the district marked on the bottom.
description: Białystok uses turquoise street signs, with the district marked on the bottom.

title: Szczecin uses colourful green and blue signs.
description: Szczecin uses colourful green and blue signs. The city district is marked on the bottom.

title: Flat landscapes like this in Bhutan can only be found in the south.
description: Flat landscapes like this in Bhutan can only be found in the south.

title: Gdańsk
description: Gdańsk is a large city in northwestern Poland. Its historic downtown features unique buildings that were inspired by Dutch Golden Age architecture. These buildings look somewhat similar to Amsterdam.

title: In Francistown, you can often see a lone hill with radio antennas, which is located on the north side of the city.
description: In Francistown, you can often see a lone hill with radio antennas, which is located on the north side of the city. This hill is a good way to distinguish Francistown from Gaborone.

title: In the city of Sylhet there will often be a guard at the side of the car visible, usually holding a hayfork.
description: In the city of Sylhet there will often be a guard at the side of the car visible, usually holding a hayfork. Note that this only applies to Generation 3 coverage.

title: The Tsodilo Hills World Heritage Site is memorable due to its large protruding hills with exposed rock faces.
description: The Tsodilo Hills World Heritage Site is memorable due to its large protruding hills with exposed rock faces. The coverage around the hills is entirely on dirt roads.

title: The main road on the Hel peninsula is very recognizable: it is a coastal forest road with a railway track running parallel to it.
description: The main road on the Hel peninsula is very recognizable: it is a coastal forest road with a railway track running parallel to it.

title: Two solid white outside lines are only seen in western Bhutan south and close to the capital Thimphu.
description: Two solid white outside lines are only seen in western Bhutan south and close to the capital Thimphu.

title: Street signs in Poznań are mainly black, with the district being marked on the blue section at the bottom.
description: Street signs in Poznań are mainly black, with the district being marked on the blue section at the bottom.

title: Just outside Gaborone, there is a lot of coverage along very rural, small dirt tracks.
description: Just outside Gaborone, there is a lot of coverage along very rural, small dirt tracks. They can be identified by the orange-red shade of dirt and abundance of green trees and bushes surrounding the road.

title: Maun is the only relatively large city in Botswana that has this bright white sandy soil, which is typical for the middle western region of the country.
description: Maun is the only relatively large city in Botswana that has this bright white sandy soil, which is typical for the middle western region of the country.

title: These distinctive silos are found in Pandamatenga in northeastern Botswana and can be seen all around the town.
description: These distinctive silos are found in Pandamatenga in northeastern Botswana and can be seen all around the town.

title: Southeast of Tshabong, the A20 has been recently repainted and has very bright yellow lines and relatively dark asphalt.
description: Southeast of Tshabong, the A20 has been recently repainted and has very bright yellow lines and relatively dark asphalt. There is a powerline running alongside it to the northeast, it has orange-tan sandy soil, and you can often find patches of yellow flowers.

title: A sizable east-west ridge can be seen on the Indian border from the northern parts of Sylhet and eastern Mymensingh.
description: A sizable east-west ridge can be seen on the Indian border from the northern parts of Sylhet and eastern Mymensingh. It is often obscured or diminished by heavy haze.

title: A scooter trekker, where mostly the left mirror and some hair is visible, can be found on Hatiya Island.
description: A scooter trekker, where mostly the left mirror and some hair is visible, can be found on Hatiya Island.

title: Chobe Flood Plains National Park in the far north has a lot of small, winding dirt road coverage, with a lot of it being just south of the Chobe River.
description: Chobe Flood Plains National Park in the far north has a lot of small, winding dirt road coverage, with a lot of it being just south of the Chobe River. It has scattered lush bushes on either side, and you will often find wildlife such as elephants and warthogs.

title: The Tatra Mountains are the highest mountains in Poland.
description: The Tatra Mountains are the highest mountains in Poland. They can be found near Zakopane, on the border with Slovakia.

title: The trekker with red colour in the mirrors is unique to the island of Nijhum Dwip.
description: The trekker with red colour in the mirrors is unique to the island of Nijhum Dwip.

title: Gaborone is the capital and largest city.
description: Gaborone is the capital and largest city. It tends to look richer and more developed than the rest of Botswana, though some neighbourhoods may still look impoverished. In some southern parts of the city hills can be seen, but most of the town is flat.

title: The southeastern region near Gaborone has many semi-arid hills covered in short shrubs.
description: The southeastern region near Gaborone has many semi-arid hills covered in short shrubs. If you see a lot of these, you are likely to be in the area between Gaborone and Lobatse.

title: Shitcam coverage
description: Shitcam coverage is only found in and around Dhaka.

title: Sunflower fields
description: Sunflower fields are found in the south of Barishal state.

title: Vast rice fields with almost nothing else in view can be seen in the border area between the states of Dhaka, Mymensingh and Sylhet.
description: Vast rice fields with almost nothing else in view can be seen in the border area between the states of Dhaka, Mymensingh and Sylhet.

title: This portion of the A30 has a distinct autumn feel unique to it.
description: This portion of the A30 has a distinct autumn feel unique to it. Notably, there are trees with orange coloured leaves lining the road in straight rows. In addition, there is often tall grass as opposed to other autumn looking locations.

title: Tiled roofs
description: Tiled roofs are uncommon in Bangladesh, but the ones you do see are of West Bengal origin, and are thus only found on the Indian border in the state of Khulna.

title: Tea production
description: Tea production in Bangladesh is concentrated in the highlands of southern Sylhet and, rarely, Chittagong.

title: Generation 3
description: Generation 3 coverage with the white Street View car can be found in Dhaka, Chattogram as well as on the highway connecting them.

title: The road that runs along Botswana’s southern border, through the town of Middlepits, has asphalt with a distinct red tint.
description: The road that runs along Botswana’s southern border, through the town of Middlepits, has asphalt with a distinct red tint. The landscape is arid. In some sections, slight hills can be seen.

title: The western part of the A2 has overcast coverage, making it recognisable.
description: The western part of the A2 has overcast coverage, making it recognisable.

title: The mostly unpaved road north of Maun to Khwai can be identified by extremely white sandy soil and tall green trees surrounding the road.
description: The mostly unpaved road north of Maun to Khwai can be identified by extremely white sandy soil and tall green trees surrounding the road. The first section of the road, between Maun and Shorobe, is paved. But that section can still be identified by the trees, faint road markings, and power lines to the west of the road.

title: Fields of watermelons can also be found in the south of Barishal.
description: Fields of watermelons can also be found in the south of Barishal.

title: The section of the A33 within the Sibuya Forest Reserve and the CT/3 (Tamafupa) Commercial Wildlife Utilisation is under construction.
description: The section of the A33 within the Sibuya Forest Reserve and the CT/3 (Tamafupa) Commercial Wildlife Utilisation is under construction. This is most visible by the service road or embankment alongside the road.

title: The A33 is characterised by a landscape that is more lush than usual.
description: The A33 is characterised by a landscape that is more lush than usual. Trees have lots of green leaves and the grass is very tall. The more north you go, the more lush the vegetation becomes.

title: Beach Sheoaks
description: Beach Sheoaks (Casuarina equisetifolia) are thin evergreen trees with thin, long, drooping branchlets. Like the name suggests, they are mostly observed in coastal regions - along the coast of the Teknaf Peninsula and around Noakhali city in Chittagong.

title: The A35 is a very recognisable road: there is always a power line to your west.
description: The A35 is a very recognisable road: there is always a power line to your west. It can also be recognised by its grainy asphalt with faded markings. Many small tracks can be found parallel to the road, disappearing into the bushes.

title: The A20 has mostly clean, recent asphalt.
description: The A20 has mostly clean, recent asphalt. Some sections of the road are much thinner than usual. The landscape is characterised by red soil, dry grey-coloured trees, and very little grass.

title: Orchards
description: Orchards are mostly concentrated around the towns of Grójec and Sandomierz in southeastern Poland.

title: While rare, bilingual signs can be found in the highlighted regions.
description: While rare, bilingual signs can be found in the highlighted regions.

title: Harvested rice
description: Harvested rice can be identified by its beige or brown colour and shorter, cut down appearance. It can be seen alongside fully-grown, unharvested rice as well as freshly planted early growth rice in adjacent fields. This is most commonly seen in the states of Sylhet and southern Khulna.

title: Canola
description: Canola is a low-growing crop with yellow flowers that is used to make cooking oil. It is usually planted during the off-season for rice, making it extremely common north of Padma river in the state of Dhaka.

title: Rice fields require some rest time, so it's natural to come across some off-season barren, empty fields without rice altogether.
description: Rice fields require some rest time, so it's natural to come across some off-season barren, empty fields without rice altogether. Off-season fields are mostly seen in the state of Dhaka, north of Padma River.

title: Jute is a tall-growing green crop which gets dried and used in the making of rugs, bags and other goods.
description: Jute is a tall-growing green crop which gets dried and used in the making of rugs, bags and other goods. Because of when the coverage was taken, jute can almost exclusively be found on Street View in Rangpur. In its dried state it can be found hanging off fences and drying on the roads anywhere in the country.

title: For legal reasons, Google has added small labels noting their copyright on all Street View coverage.
description: For legal reasons, Google has added small labels noting their copyright on all Street View coverage. These labels contain a year, typically the year when the coverage was released, which can be used to regionguess Bangladesh. Generation 4 coverage with 2022 written on the copyright labels can be found in Mymensingh, Dhaka and less commonly Chittagong.

title: While most of Bangladesh is almost completely flat, in the eastern parts of Chittagong you may find fairly tall, forested and uncultivated hills.
description: While most of Bangladesh is almost completely flat, in the eastern parts of Chittagong you may find fairly tall, forested and uncultivated hills.

title: Salt pans
description: Salt pans can be found in central-eastern Botswana. Dirt road coverage can be found leading to the pans and has similar soil and grass, but you can also find many trees along the road. They are mainly found around the Nwetwe pan. The salt pans show up as lakes on the map.

title: Rice is the main agricultural crop in Bangladesh and is planted twice a year.
description: Rice is the main agricultural crop in Bangladesh and is planted twice a year. The different rice seasons can be told apart by the height and colour of the rice and are very useful for regionguessing.

title: Generation 3
description: Generation 3 coverage with the striped Street View car can be found mostly on yellow roads west of Dhaka.

title: The landscape in the eastern pocket north of Francistown is characterised by red soil and a somewhat arid look.
description: The landscape in the eastern pocket north of Francistown is characterised by red soil and a somewhat arid look. The soil in these two areas often looks firm and rocky, rather than sandy or dusty. Trees and bushes with yellowed leaves and other “autumn” colours are common. Many trees are bare and withered. You might see fallen leaves on the ground here and there.

title: Blossoming trees
description: Blossoming trees are tied to coverage and seasonal metas in Bangladesh, and are only found in the states where coverage was taken during spring time - Khulna, Mymensingh and southern Dhaka.

title: Traditional wooden houses are commonly found in the east, mainly in Podlaskie Voivodeship.
description: Traditional wooden houses are commonly found in the east, mainly in Podlaskie Voivodeship.

title: Markings with a white background are most commonly found in Podlaskie voivodeship, and can occasionally be seen in Łódź voivodeship and elsewhere.
description: Markings with a white background are most commonly found in Podlaskie voivodeship, and can occasionally be seen in Łódź voivodeship and elsewhere.

title: Corn
description: Corn tends to be planted in the west of Bangladesh - large and medium-sized fields can be found in Rajshahi, Rangpur, western Mymensingh and northern Khulna.

title: Standalone fruit trees in Bangladesh are most commonly seen in the states of Rajshahi and Rangpur.
description: Standalone fruit trees in Bangladesh are most commonly seen in the states of Rajshahi and Rangpur. Fruit orchards with systematically planted trees, however, are concentrated near the Indian border in both states.

title: Fully-grown rice
description: Fully-grown rice is characterised by being noticeably taller, as well as having a yellow or orange colour and fluffier tips - the fluffiness signifies that the rice is ripe. Fully-grown rice is mostly seen in the state of Rajshahi, but it is also present in Rangpur and Chittagong.

title: Most of Botswana is as flat as a pancake.
description: Most of Botswana is as flat as a pancake. However, every now and then you will find some elevation. If you see hills, you are most likely in one of the two areas indicated on the minimap.

title: Even though most of Poland is flat, the southern border area is very hilly.
description: Even though most of Poland is flat, the southern border area is very hilly. Some parts even have mountains.

title: In the east, you will commonly see sheet metal roofs with a triangular "window" just below the ridge of the roof.
description: In the east, you will commonly see sheet metal roofs with a triangular "window" just below the ridge of the roof. The state of Sylhet will exclusively have this style, which can also be seen in Chittagong, Mymensingh, eastern Rangpur and northern Dhaka.

title: These signs are frequently found in the cities of Bhutan and are often coloured red or blue.
description: These signs are frequently found in the cities of Bhutan and are often coloured red or blue.

title: Prayer flags
description: Prayer flags near the road are typically seen in Bhutan.

title: Licence plates in Bhutan are almost always red and can easily be seen on vehicles.
description: Licence plates in Bhutan are almost always red and can easily be seen on vehicles.

title: Taxis in Bhutan have yellow licence plates and yellow roofs.
description: Taxis in Bhutan have yellow licence plates and yellow roofs.

title: Thin metal poles
description: Thin metal poles are occasionally found in Bhutan. They are often painted black at the bottom.

title: Bhutan is a mountainous country and most of the coverage is located on its main mountain roads.
description: Bhutan is a mountainous country and most of the coverage is located on its main mountain roads.

title: These are the Bhutanese road markers, notice the yellow top and the white bottom.
description: These are the Bhutanese road markers, notice the yellow top and the white bottom.

title: Dzongkha
description: Dzongkha is an official language in Bhutan and has unique-looking letters.

title: Signposts in Bhutan frequently have black-and-white stripes.
description: Signposts in Bhutan frequently have black-and-white stripes.

title: Bhutan commonly uses these stone blocks as safety barriers on winding rural roads.
description: Bhutan commonly uses these stone blocks as safety barriers on winding rural roads. These blocks are very common and often one of the best ways to recognize rural Bhutan rounds.

title: The traditional Bhutanese architecture is very distinct.
description: The traditional Bhutanese architecture is very distinct. Most of the houses have tin roofs and wooden painted frames, which give them a unique look.

title: Coverage in Bhutan was taken by a grey Google car without an antenna.
description: Coverage in Bhutan was taken by a grey Google car without an antenna.

title: Eucalyptus trees
description: Eucalyptus trees are tall trees with lush crowns and ivory-coloured trunks. In Bangladesh they are more common in the north, with Rangpur, Rajshahi and Mymensingh being the most likely states.

title: Slightly taller rice, in the middle of growing, which still remains green, can be seen in the states of Rangpur, Barishal and Chittagong.
description: Slightly taller rice, in the middle of growing, which still remains green, can be seen in the states of Rangpur, Barishal and Chittagong.

title: A large region in the middle western part of the country is characterised by very white sandy soil.
description: A large region in the middle western part of the country is characterised by very white sandy soil. In addition, the vegetation tends to look very dry.

title: Black pole markings
description: Black pole markings are most commonly seen in the southeast of the country, as well as some areas in the north.

title: Bangladesh has several distinct roof styles that create an east/west divide in the country.
description: Bangladesh has several distinct roof styles that create an east/west divide in the country.

title: Electricity poles with yellow markings are predominantly found in western and southern Poland.
description: Electricity poles with yellow markings are predominantly found in western and southern Poland.

title: Similarly, Generation 4 coverage with 2023 written on the copyright labels can be found in Rangpur, Rajshahi, Khulna, Barishal, Sylhet and less commonly Chittagong.
description: Similarly, Generation 4 coverage with 2023 written on the copyright labels can be found in Rangpur, Rajshahi, Khulna, Barishal, Sylhet and less commonly Chittagong.

title: Tin roofs
description: Tin roofs are commonly found in Bangladesh.

title: The Generation 4 coverage in Bangladesh will often have a smoky feel to it.
description: The Generation 4 coverage in Bangladesh will often have a smoky feel to it.

title: In Generation 3 coverage, these three cars can be seen in Bangladesh: the red mirror with bars, classic white and striped white car.
description: In Generation 3 coverage, these three cars can be seen in Bangladesh: the red mirror with bars, classic white and striped white car.

title: Streets in Bangladesh are often lined by trees, which sometimes have white paint on the bottom of their trunks.
description: Streets in Bangladesh are often lined by trees, which sometimes have white paint on the bottom of their trunks.

title: Bodies of water
description: Bodies of water and agricultural fields can be often seen beside the streets of Bangladesh.

title: Bangladesh, as well as a variety of other countries, has received some poor quality coverage, also known as “Shitcam”.
description: Bangladesh, as well as a variety of other countries, has received some poor quality coverage, also known as “Shitcam”. The Shitcam car colours are black and white.

title: In Generation 4 coverage, two Street View cars can be seen in Bangladesh: a black car and a white car.
description: In Generation 4 coverage, two Street View cars can be seen in Bangladesh: a black car and a white car.

title: The Bengali script features a continuous horizontal line at the top of each word.
description: The Bengali script features a continuous horizontal line at the top of each word. It has a similar look to Devanagari (Hindi and Nepali), however it can usually be recognised by the many letters featuring triangular shapes.

title: Bangladesh uses red-and-white concrete bollards throughout the whole country.
description: Bangladesh uses red-and-white concrete bollards throughout the whole country.

title: Signposts in Bangladesh often have black-and-white stripes.
description: Signposts in Bangladesh often have black-and-white stripes.

title: Bangladeshi licence plates are either white, black or turquoise.
description: Bangladeshi licence plates are either white, black or turquoise.

title: Rickshaws
description: Rickshaws are frequently found all around Bangladesh, especially the green auto rickshaws.

title: Street lamps mounted on top of the pole become more common towards the northeast of the country, with some pockets in the far south.
description: Street lamps mounted on top of the pole become more common towards the northeast of the country, with some pockets in the far south.

title: In contrast, lamps attached to the side of the pole are rarely found in the northeast.
description: In contrast, lamps attached to the side of the pole are rarely found in the northeast.

title: Many roads in Poland are lined by rows of trees.
description: Many roads in Poland are lined by rows of trees.

title: Polish chevrons are white with red arrows.
description: Polish chevrons are white with red arrows.

title: Poland has two town entry signs: a green one with the locality’s name, and a white-and-black one with a stylized urban area.
description: Poland has two town entry signs: a green one with the locality’s name, and a white-and-black one with a stylized urban area.

title: Polish
description: Polish is a Slavic language. In contrast to other slavic languages, the Polish alphabet includes:

title: Poland is one of the most Catholic countries in Europe.
description: Poland is one of the most Catholic countries in Europe. You can often find Christian shrines on the side of roads. Blue-white and yellow-white Polish Catholic flags also sometimes appear.

title: Neatly tiled sidewalks are very common in Poland.
description: Neatly tiled sidewalks are very common in Poland. Tiles are often grey or light red. Occasionally, even roads have tiled pavement. Many different types of tile patterns occur, including larger square tiles.

title: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Poland.
description: A white generation 4 Google car can also rarely be found in Poland.

title: Warning signs are triangular and have a yellow background and a distinct thin red border.
description: Warning signs are triangular and have a yellow background and a distinct thin red border.

title: However, prohibitory signs are round and have a white background with a thicker red border.
description: However, prohibitory signs are round and have a white background with a thicker red border.

title: Regular Polish direction signs have a green background.
description: Regular Polish direction signs have a green background. These signs use a distinct font, which is a good clue for Poland.

title: When it comes to Polish place names, the -owo ending is mostly limited to the northern half of the country, and the -ów ending mostly to the southern half.
description: When it comes to Polish place names, the -owo ending is mostly limited to the northern half of the country, and the -ów ending mostly to the southern half. You may also encounter -ino or -yno, mainly in the northwest, and -ew near the centre of the country.

title: Poland usually has thin concrete utility poles with see-through holes.
description: Poland usually has thin concrete utility poles with see-through holes. They are commonly known as “holey poles”. The holes often do not extend all the way to the bottom of the pole.

title: Poland is generally a flat country, with occasional rolling hills.
description: Poland is generally a flat country, with occasional rolling hills. The country is very green, with a lot of agriculture, and some amount of forest cover.

title: Poland has a unique pedestrian sign.
description: Poland has a unique pedestrian sign. Instead of the usual zebra stripes, it just has a single horizontal line.

title: Polish architecture
description: Polish architecture is fairly similar to other Central European countries. Buildings usually have plain stone walls covered in light or pastel stucco. Frequent roofing colours are orange or red, black, and brown. Roof tiles and panes often have a tidy, almost plastic-like look. Some rural houses have corrugated sheet roofs similar to those often found in the Baltics.

title: Poland has square (normal B-type) guardrails, with circular red reflectors.
description: Poland has square (normal B-type) guardrails, with circular red reflectors.

title: Poland has all-white road lines.
description: Poland has all-white road lines. Double middle lines are very common and usually a good clue for Poland.

title: A black generation 4 Google car can rarely be found in Poland.
description: A black generation 4 Google car can rarely be found in Poland.

title: Polish bollards have a red strip that wraps all the way around the bollard.
description: Polish bollards have a red strip that wraps all the way around the bollard. This strip has a red reflector on the front (sometimes hard to see), and a white reflector on the back. Bollards sometimes have numbers on them.

title: Poland has long white plates with the standard European blue strip on the left.
description: Poland has long white plates with the standard European blue strip on the left.

title: Some road signs have a blue background.
description: Some road signs have a blue background. This is an older style of sign that was used before signs with white backgrounds were introduced. They are relatively unique to Botswana.

title: Botswana has white front plates and yellow rear plates, similar to UK-style plates.
description: Botswana has white front plates and yellow rear plates, similar to UK-style plates.

title: Like the other countries in Southern Africa, outside road lines (if present) are yellow, while centre road lines are white.
description: Like the other countries in Southern Africa, outside road lines (if present) are yellow, while centre road lines are white.

title: The typical Botswana landscape is dry and mostly flat, though a limited amount of elevation can be found in certain regions.
description: The typical Botswana landscape is dry and mostly flat, though a limited amount of elevation can be found in certain regions. Common vegetation includes shrubs, small trees, and occasionally dry, golden grasslands. The soil is arid, sandy and ranges in colour from white to red.

title: Typical Botswana houses range from small impoverished shacks to comfortable middle-class bungalows.
description: Typical Botswana houses range from small impoverished shacks to comfortable middle-class bungalows. Some buildings have exposed grey bricks. On occasion, you might find traditional round huts.

title: Just like the other Southern African countries, direction signs have a green background.
description: Just like the other Southern African countries, direction signs have a green background.

title: These small red-and-white chevrons can sometimes be found next to the road.
description: These small red-and-white chevrons can sometimes be found next to the road.

title: Signs in Botswana are usually in English.
description: Signs in Botswana are usually in English. Most town names, however, are derived from any of the indigenous languages spoken in the country.

title: Random small blurs
description: Random small blurs are common in Botswana’s coverage. These blurs are similar to the ones found on licence plates and faces, but they cover seemingly random parts of the panorama instead. This is especially noticeable in urban areas, and mostly absent on more rural roads.

title: Botswana has many unique and distinct regions throughout the country.
description: Botswana has many unique and distinct regions throughout the country. This image breaks down the main factors that differentiate each distinctive landscape by soil, vegetation and other clues.

title: Curbs and guardrails are usually striped.
description: Curbs and guardrails are usually striped. Possible colour schemes are black-and-yellow, red-and-white, and black-and-white.

title: Botswana has a unique black-and-yellow striped signpost.
description: Botswana has a unique black-and-yellow striped signpost. More rarely, you can see red-and-white signposts.

title: All of Botswana was covered by a white Google car without an antenna.
description: All of Botswana was covered by a white Google car without an antenna.
